patch_description: The current program can spend a large share of its LP budget scoring oversized batches, while its operator adaptation mainly rewards whether a proposal beats its immediate parent. This version uses batches of at most two, so feedback can guide more search steps. It adds a simulated-annealing walker alongside a quality- and diversity-ranked archive, and adapts operator probabilities from smoothed LP-confirmed success rates. Candidate moves are screened using surrogate-energy and bottleneck-dual rankings, with randomized selection among the leaders to retain exploration. The initial LP-scored seed set is reduced to 22 to leave more budget for iterative search.
